verdict.rationale: Qapita's own 409A valuations page claims independent, audit-ready valuations from qualified experts, so the core valuation service is a first-party offering. The evidence does not show that it is ordered inside the platform, built from live cap table data, or refreshed on a schedule. missing for 10: in-platform ordering flow, generation from live cap table data, scheduled/recurring refresh valuations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
